examples.en: Her first grandchild was born in the spring.
examples.zh: 她的第一個孫子在春天出生。

examples.en: Grandma bakes cookies whenever her grandchild comes to visit.
examples.zh: 只要孫女來訪，奶奶就會烤餅乾。

examples.en: Each grandchild received a red envelope at the New Year dinner.
examples.zh: 每個孫子在年夜飯上都收到一個紅包。

examples.en: My grandparents live in a small village near the sea.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母住在海邊的一個小村莊。

examples.en: A grandparent often helps take care of young children.
examples.zh: 祖父母常常幫忙照顧年幼的孩子。

examples.en: On weekends, we visit our grandparents and have lunch together.
examples.zh: 週末我們會去探望祖父母，一起吃午餐。

examples.en: Your help has greatly improved our project.
examples.zh: 你的幫忙大大改善了我們的專案。

examples.en: The price of rice has greatly increased this year.
examples.zh: 今年米價大幅上漲。

examples.en: We greatly appreciate your quick reply to our email.
examples.zh: 我們非常感謝你迅速回覆我們的電子郵件。

examples.en: Children must be with a grown-up when they enter the pool.
examples.zh: 孩子進入泳池時必須有大人陪同。

examples.en: The grown-ups talked in the kitchen while the kids played outside.
examples.zh: 大人們在廚房聊天，孩子們則在外面玩。

examples.en: Ask a grown-up for help if you cannot find the exit.
examples.zh: 如果找不到出口，就請大人幫忙。

examples.en: She has two grown-up sons who live abroad.
examples.zh: 她有兩個已成年的兒子住在國外。

examples.en: He is only twelve, but he acts very grown-up.
examples.zh: 他才十二歲，但表現得非常成熟。

examples.en: It is time to make a grown-up decision about your future.
examples.zh: 是時候為你的未來做一個成熟的決定了。

examples.en: We stopped for water halfway up the mountain.
examples.zh: 我們爬到半山腰時停下來喝水。

examples.en: The bus broke down halfway between the two cities.
examples.zh: 公車在兩座城市的中途拋錨了。

examples.en: She left the meeting halfway through the presentation.
examples.zh: 她在簡報進行到一半時離開了會議。

examples.en: The halfway point of the hike is a small temple.
examples.zh: 健行路線的中間點是一座小廟。

examples.en: We reached the halfway mark of the exam in thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 我們花了三十分鐘就寫到考試的一半。

examples.en: The runners cheered when they passed the halfway line.
examples.zh: 跑者們越過中間線時歡呼起來。

examples.en: She put her wallet and keys in her handbag.
examples.zh: 她把錢包和鑰匙放進手提包裡。

examples.en: This leather handbag is on sale at the department store.
examples.zh: 這個皮製手提包在百貨公司特價中。

examples.en: A small umbrella fits easily inside her handbag.
examples.zh: 一把小傘很容易就放進她的手提包裡。

examples.en: My sister is a hardworking student who studies every night.
examples.zh: 我姊姊是個勤奮的學生，每晚都讀書。

examples.en: The company is looking for a hardworking assistant to join the team.
examples.zh: 公司正在找一位勤奮的助理加入團隊。

examples.en: Our hardworking neighbors cleaned the street after the festival.
examples.zh: 我們勤奮的鄰居們在慶典後打掃了街道。

examples.en: Returning the shoes without a receipt was a big hassle.
examples.zh: 沒有收據要退鞋子真是很麻煩。

examples.en: Taking the MRT saves us the hassle of finding a parking space.
examples.zh: 搭捷運讓我們省去找停車位的麻煩。

examples.en: Booking online is easy and without any hassle.
examples.zh: 線上訂位很簡單，一點也不麻煩。

examples.en: My parents keep hassling me about my grades.
examples.zh: 我爸媽一直為了成績煩我。

examples.en: Please don't hassle the clerk about the price; it is fixed.
examples.zh: 請不要為了價格去煩店員，這是固定價格。

examples.en: He felt hassled by the constant phone calls from the office.
examples.zh: 辦公室不斷打來的電話讓他覺得很煩。

examples.en: The headmaster gave a short speech at the opening ceremony.
examples.zh: 校長在開幕典禮上發表了簡短的演說。

examples.en: Our headmaster greets students at the school gate every morning.
examples.zh: 我們的校長每天早上在校門口迎接學生。

examples.en: The parents asked the headmaster about the new school rules.
examples.zh: 家長們向校長詢問新的校規。

examples.en: I wear headphones on the MRT so I can listen to music.
examples.zh: 我在捷運上戴耳機聽音樂。

examples.en: These headphones are comfortable enough to wear all day.
examples.zh: 這副耳機舒適到可以整天戴著。

examples.en: Please use headphones in the library so you do not disturb others.
examples.zh: 請在圖書館使用耳機，以免打擾他人。

senses.zh: 頭戴式耳機；耳機麥克風

examples.en: The customer service agent wore a headset during the call.
examples.zh: 客服人員通話時戴著耳機麥克風。

examples.en: I need a new headset for my online English class.
examples.zh: 我需要一副新的耳機麥克風來上線上英語課。

examples.en: My headset has a built-in microphone, so I can join video meetings.
examples.zh: 我的頭戴式耳機有內建麥克風，所以可以參加視訊會議。

examples.en: She felt deep heartbreak when her best friend moved away.
examples.zh: 她最好的朋友搬走時，她感到非常心碎。

examples.en: The movie is about love and heartbreak in a small town.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述小鎮中的愛情與心碎。

examples.en: It took him months to recover from the heartbreak of the breakup.
examples.zh: 他花了好幾個月才從分手的傷痛中走出來。

senses.zh: 天堂般的；美妙的；天上的

examples.en: The cake tasted heavenly, and everyone asked for a second slice.
examples.zh: 這個蛋糕美味極了，每個人都想再吃一片。

examples.en: We spent a heavenly weekend at a hot spring hotel.
examples.zh: 我們在溫泉旅館度過了美好的週末。

examples.en: Astronomers study heavenly bodies such as stars and planets.
examples.zh: 天文學家研究恆星和行星等天體。

senses.zh: 隱藏的；隱蔽的；不為人知的

examples.en: We found a hidden path behind the old school building.
examples.zh: 我們在舊校舍後面發現了一條隱蔽的小路。

examples.en: There are no hidden fees when you buy tickets online.
examples.zh: 線上購票沒有任何隱藏費用。

examples.en: Her hidden talent for singing surprised the whole class.
examples.zh: 她不為人知的歌唱才能讓全班都嚇了一跳。

examples.en: Many people in Taipei live in a high-rise near the MRT station.
examples.zh: 許多台北人住在捷運站附近的高樓大廈裡。

examples.en: A new high-rise is being built across from our school.
examples.zh: 我們學校對面正在興建一棟新的高樓。

examples.en: From the top of the high-rise, we could see the whole city.
examples.zh: 從高樓頂端，我們可以看到整座城市。

examples.en: She works in a high-rise office building in the city center.
examples.zh: 她在市中心的一棟高層辦公大樓工作。

examples.en: The high-rise apartments along the river have great views.
examples.zh: 河岸旁的高樓公寓視野很棒。

examples.en: We stayed in a high-rise hotel with a view of the bay.
examples.zh: 我們住在一間能看到海灣的高樓飯店。

examples.en: Airport staff practice what to do if a hijacker appears on a plane.
examples.zh: 機場人員會演練飛機上出現劫機者時該怎麼做。

examples.en: The movie is about a pilot who talks to a hijacker.
examples.zh: 這部電影講的是一位和劫機者交談的機師。

examples.en: Police said the hijacker had surrendered without hurting anyone.
examples.zh: 警方表示劫機者已投降，沒有傷害任何人。

examples.en: The hikers stopped to rest by the stream.
examples.zh: 健行者們停下來在溪邊休息。

examples.en: A friendly hiker showed us the way to the top.
examples.zh: 一位親切的登山客帶我們走向山頂。

examples.en: Experienced hikers carry plenty of water and a map.
examples.zh: 有經驗的健行者會帶足夠的水和一張地圖。

examples.en: Honestly, I did not understand the teacher's question.
examples.zh: 老實說，我沒聽懂老師的問題。

examples.en: She answered all the interview questions honestly.
examples.zh: 她誠實地回答了所有面試問題。

examples.en: He honestly believes that practice is the key to success.
examples.zh: 他真心相信練習是成功的關鍵。

examples.en: Hopefully, the rain will stop before the baseball game starts.
examples.zh: 希望雨能在棒球比賽開始前停。

examples.en: "Will you come tomorrow?" she asked hopefully.
examples.zh: 「你明天會來嗎？」她滿懷希望地問。

examples.en: We will hopefully arrive in Tainan before noon.
examples.zh: 我們應該能在中午前抵達台南。

examples.en: She missed two weeks of school because of a serious illness.
examples.zh: 她因為一場重病缺課了兩週。

examples.en: A good diet can help prevent illness.
examples.zh: 良好的飲食有助於預防疾病。

examples.en: The doctor said the illness was not contagious.
examples.zh: 醫生說這種疾病不會傳染。

examples.en: This hotel offers every imaginable service for its guests.
examples.zh: 這間飯店為旅客提供所有想得到的服務。

examples.en: It was the worst traffic jam imaginable.
examples.zh: 那是你所能想像最嚴重的塞車。

examples.en: It is hardly imaginable that a small shop could sell so many books in a day.
examples.zh: 很難想像一家小店一天能賣出這麼多書。

examples.en: Please call me immediately if you need any help.
examples.zh: 如果需要幫忙，請立刻打電話給我。

examples.en: The students stood up immediately when the teacher walked in.
examples.zh: 老師走進來時，學生們立刻起立。

examples.en: The coffee shop is immediately next to the bookstore.
examples.zh: 那家咖啡店就緊鄰書店。

examples.en: The email from the company sounded cold and impersonal.
examples.zh: 公司寄來的電子郵件讀起來冷淡又不帶感情。

examples.en: Big city hospitals can feel impersonal to new patients.
examples.zh: 大城市的醫院對新病患來說可能顯得冷冰冰的。

examples.en: Writers usually use an impersonal tone in formal reports.
examples.zh: 寫作者通常在正式報告中使用客觀中立的語氣。

examples.en: Your English has shown great improvement this semester.
examples.zh: 你的英文這學期進步很多。

examples.en: The city plans several improvements to the bus system.
examples.zh: 市府計畫對公車系統做幾項改善。

examples.en: There is still room for improvement in our service.
examples.zh: 我們的服務仍有改進的空間。

examples.en: Online shopping is becoming increasingly popular in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 網路購物在台灣越來越受歡迎。

examples.en: The weather grew increasingly cold as we climbed higher.
examples.zh: 我們爬得越高，天氣就越來越冷。

examples.en: She felt increasingly nervous before the speech.
examples.zh: 演講前她越來越緊張。

examples.en: India is a large country in South Asia.
examples.zh: 印度是南亞的一個大國。

examples.en: My cousin is planning a trip to India next spring.
examples.zh: 我的表哥計畫明年春天去印度旅行。

examples.en: Our teacher showed us a map of India in class.
examples.zh: 老師在課堂上給我們看了印度的地圖。

examples.en: Readers use clues in the story to make an inference.
examples.zh: 讀者利用故事中的線索做出推論。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to draw an inference from the chart.
examples.zh: 老師要我們從圖表中得出一個推論。

examples.en: Scientists base each inference on careful observation.
examples.zh: 科學家根據仔細的觀察做出每項推論。

examples.en: The party was informal, so everyone wore jeans.
examples.zh: 這場派對很隨興，所以大家都穿牛仔褲。

examples.en: This email sounds too informal for a job application.
examples.zh: 這封電子郵件對求職來說聽起來太隨便了。

examples.en: We had an informal chat with the manager over lunch.
examples.zh: 我們在午餐時和經理進行了一場輕鬆的閒聊。

examples.en: She is well informed about current events.
examples.zh: 她對時事瞭若指掌。

examples.en: Make an informed choice before you buy a new phone.
examples.zh: 買新手機之前，先做出有根據的選擇。

examples.en: Parents were kept informed about changes to the school schedule.
examples.zh: 家長們隨時獲知學校課表的變動。

examples.en: Buying a house is usually the biggest investment in a person's life.
examples.zh: 買房子通常是一個人一生中最大的一筆投資。

examples.en: The company made a large investment in new software last year.
examples.zh: 這家公司去年在新軟體上投入了大筆資金。

examples.en: Learning English is a good investment in your future.
examples.zh: 學英文是對你未來的一項好投資。

examples.en: Investors were pleased with the company's new profit report.
examples.zh: 投資人對公司新的獲利報告感到滿意。

examples.en: A young investor should learn about risk first.
examples.zh: 年輕的投資人應該先了解風險。

examples.en: The startup is looking for an investor to support its new app.
examples.zh: 這家新創公司正在尋找投資人來支持它的新應用程式。

examples.en: Air is invisible, but we can feel it when the wind blows.
examples.zh: 空氣看不見，但風吹時我們能感覺到它。

examples.en: In the story, a magic cloak makes the boy invisible.
examples.zh: 故事裡，一件魔法斗篷讓男孩隱形了。

examples.en: Tiny germs are invisible to the human eye.
examples.zh: 微小的細菌是人眼看不見的。

examples.en: The bus driver kindly helped the old man find his seat.
examples.zh: 公車司機親切地幫老先生找座位。

examples.en: Kindly turn off your phones during the movie.
examples.zh: 電影放映期間請關閉手機。

examples.en: She smiled kindly and offered us some tea.
examples.zh: 她親切地微笑，並請我們喝茶。

examples.en: The kindly old doctor treated all his patients like family.
examples.zh: 這位和藹的老醫生把所有病人都當成家人。

examples.en: She has a kindly face that makes children feel safe.
examples.zh: 她有一張和藹的臉，讓孩子們感到安心。

examples.en: A kindly neighbor gave us a ride home.
examples.zh: 一位親切的鄰居載我們回家。

examples.en: Thank you for your kindness during my stay in Taipei.
examples.zh: 謝謝你在我待在台北期間的親切照顧。

examples.en: The teacher treated every student with kindness and patience.
examples.zh: 老師以親切和耐心對待每一位學生。

examples.en: A small act of kindness can make someone's day.
examples.zh: 一個小小的善舉就能讓人開心一整天。

examples.en: The lavatory is at the end of the corridor.
examples.zh: 洗手間在走廊的盡頭。

examples.en: Please ask the flight attendant if the lavatory is free.
examples.zh: 請詢問空服員洗手間是否有人使用。

examples.en: The lavatory in this café is clean and well lit.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡店的洗手間乾淨又明亮。

examples.en: Dr. Lin is a leading expert on ocean life.
examples.zh: 林博士是海洋生物的權威專家。

examples.en: Taiwan is a leading producer of computer chips.
examples.zh: 台灣是電腦晶片的主要生產地之一。

examples.en: Heavy rain was the leading cause of the delay.
examples.zh: 大雨是延誤的主要原因。

examples.en: A volunteer handed me a leaflet about the school festival.
examples.zh: 一位志工遞給我一張校慶的傳單。

examples.en: The leaflet explains how to use the new bike-sharing system.
examples.zh: 這份小冊子說明如何使用新的共享單車系統。

examples.en: Please read the leaflet in the box before taking the medicine.
examples.zh: 服藥前請先閱讀盒內的說明書。

examples.en: She is a quick learner who picks up new words easily.
examples.zh: 她學得很快，很容易就學會新單字。

examples.en: Many adult learners take evening English classes.
examples.zh: 許多成年學習者會上夜間英文課。

examples.en: This app is designed for beginner learners of Japanese.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式是為初學日文的學習者設計的。

examples.en: A healthy lifestyle includes regular exercise and enough sleep.
examples.zh: 健康的生活方式包括規律運動和充足的睡眠。

examples.en: Moving to the countryside changed their lifestyle completely.
examples.zh: 搬到鄉下徹底改變了他們的生活方式。

examples.en: This magazine shares ideas about food, travel, and city lifestyle.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌分享關於美食、旅遊和都會生活方式的點子。

examples.en: Many students feel loneliness when they first live away from home.
examples.zh: 許多學生剛離家生活時會感到孤單。

examples.en: The old man talked to his cat to ease his loneliness.
examples.zh: 老先生對著他的貓說話來排解寂寞。

examples.en: Joining a club is a good way to fight loneliness.
examples.zh: 加入社團是對抗孤單的好方法。

examples.en: The two schools have a long-standing friendship.
examples.zh: 這兩所學校有著長久的友誼。

examples.en: Traffic is a long-standing problem in this part of the city.
examples.zh: 交通是這個城區由來已久的問題。

examples.en: Eating dumplings on New Year's Eve is a long-standing family tradition.
examples.zh: 除夕夜吃水餃是我們家長久以來的傳統。

examples.en: This job offers long-term security and a good salary.
examples.zh: 這份工作提供長期的保障和不錯的薪水。

examples.en: We need a long-term plan to save water.
examples.zh: 我們需要一個節約用水的長期計畫。

examples.en: Too much screen time may cause long-term damage to your eyes.
examples.zh: 螢幕使用時間過長可能對眼睛造成長期的傷害。

examples.en: A large lorry blocked the narrow road in front of our school.
examples.zh: 一輛大貨車堵住了我們學校前面的窄路。

examples.en: The lorry delivered fresh vegetables to the market at dawn.
examples.zh: 這輛貨車在黎明時把新鮮蔬菜送到市場。

examples.en: The driver parked his lorry beside the warehouse and unloaded the boxes.
examples.zh: 司機把貨車停在倉庫旁邊，開始卸下箱子。

examples.en: Lychee is a sweet, juicy fruit that people love in summer.
examples.zh: 荔枝是一種香甜多汁的水果，人們夏天很愛吃。

examples.en: She peeled a lychee and gave it to her little brother.
examples.zh: 她剝了一顆荔枝給弟弟。

examples.en: We bought a bag of fresh lychees from the fruit stand.
examples.zh: 我們在水果攤買了一袋新鮮的荔枝。

examples.en: This company is a famous maker of bicycles.
examples.zh: 這家公司是知名的腳踏車製造商。

examples.en: The maker of this toy gives a one-year guarantee.
examples.zh: 這個玩具的製造商提供一年保固。

examples.en: The makers of the app promise to fix the bug soon.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式的開發者承諾很快會修正錯誤。

examples.en: Plastic is a man-made material that takes years to break down.
examples.zh: 塑膠是一種人造材料，需要很多年才會分解。

examples.en: This man-made lake is a popular place for picnics.
examples.zh: 這座人工湖是很受歡迎的野餐地點。

examples.en: Some man-made fibers dry faster than cotton.
examples.zh: 有些人造纖維比棉乾得更快。

examples.en: The workload is heavy this week, but it is still manageable.
examples.zh: 這週工作量很大，但還應付得來。

examples.en: Dividing the project into small tasks makes it more manageable.
examples.zh: 把專案分成小任務會讓它更容易處理。

examples.en: A class of twenty students is a manageable size for one teacher.
examples.zh: 二十個學生的班級對一位老師來說是可掌握的規模。

examples.en: Good time management helps students finish their homework.
examples.zh: 良好的時間管理能幫助學生完成作業。

examples.en: The hotel management apologized for the noise last night.
examples.zh: 飯店管理階層為昨晚的噪音道歉。

examples.en: She studies business management at a university in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她在台北的一所大學修讀企業管理。

examples.en: The manager sent a memorandum about the new office rules.
examples.zh: 經理發出了一份關於新辦公室規定的內部公告。

examples.en: Please read the memorandum before tomorrow's meeting.
examples.zh: 請在明天的會議前閱讀這份備忘錄。

examples.en: The two companies signed a memorandum of understanding yesterday.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司昨天簽署了合作備忘錄。

examples.en: We usually have lunch at midday in the school cafeteria.
examples.zh: 我們通常中午在學校餐廳吃午餐。

examples.en: The sun is hottest at midday in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天正午的太陽最熱。

examples.en: The shop closes for an hour around midday.
examples.zh: 這家店在中午前後會休息一小時。
